secrets.name: The Teacher's Store Room
secrets.text: Behind the blackboard is the store room: chalk by the crate, maps rolled up, a globe with a dent in it, and on the desk the register, open, with every name you have ever had written in it, and a tick against each one: present.

secrets.name: Behind the Blackboard
secrets.text: The blackboard stands out from the wall, and there is just room to slip behind it.

meta.label: The Classroom
meta.blurb: Desks for a thousand, all facing the blackboard, and on the blackboard a lesson nobody has rubbed out. You have the uneasy feeling you were supposed to have learned it by now.
